title: Rightmove Agent Scraper
description: Extract UK estate agents and letting agents from Rightmove search results, including names, phone numbers, branch type, and listing description fields.

startUrl.title: Search URL
startUrl.description: Rightmove agent search URL. Leave empty to use search parameters below.

searchLocation.title: Search Location
searchLocation.description: Location name to search for estate agents (e.g., 'London', 'Manchester', 'Birmingham')

maxResults.title: Maximum Agents
maxResults.description: Maximum number of estate agents to collect. Leave empty to continue until results end.

maxPages.title: Maximum Pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of result pages to process. Leave empty to continue until pagination ends.

enrichProfiles.title: Enrich Agent Profiles
enrichProfiles.description: When enabled, the Actor also collects additional details from each agent page. Disabling this is much faster.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings for requests. Residential proxies recommended to avoid blocking.
